integrity: Self-contained mathematical derivation with separate brute-force implementations of graph adjacency, direct forcing and finite packing; computations support but do not prove the infinite-family statement.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the standard color-change rule on crown graphs of order 2n with n >= 3; no claims for positive semidefinite/skew variants, propagation time, or n=2. A possible unindexed equivalent formula remains a priority risk.
title: Minimal forts and the complete zero forcing spectrum of crown graphs
